verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a usage-based billing platform, since some products of this kind ship self-hostable or open-source deployments. Nothing in the evidence shows Orb offering one: every item describes a vendor-operated service (hosted API, hosted MCP server at mcp.withorb.com, managed data exports). The 'production deployments' throughput claim refers to scale, not customer-operated hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
